subject.title: perf(ci): cut the pre-fan-out critical path and bin canonical main runs

question: Is the strengthened static guard coverage sufficient for this canonical-`main`-only CI topology change, or should the branch provide a maintainer-approved proof override with first-run monitoring before merge?
rationale: The exact behavior is intentionally gated to `push` events on `refs/heads/main`, so normal PR checks cannot fully demonstrate the changed admission and compact-bin path before merge.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout with monitoring
options.body: Accept the focused guards and reported test output as sufficient, apply a proof override, and verify the first canonical main run's debounce and compact-bin behavior after merge.

options.title: Require controlled runtime evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until a CI owner provides redacted output from a controlled canonical-main-equivalent validation that shows the gate and bin selection.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout with monitoring
recommendation.body: Accept the focused guards and reported test output as sufficient, apply a proof override, and verify the first canonical main run's debounce and compact-bin behavior after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The only concrete merged-history owner available in the supplied context is the author of the TUI harness portion; CI workflow ownership needs confirmation from a reviewing maintainer.
